item.title: 💥 'We work 24/7, no days off': the Zapad Group's servicemen neutralise the enemy in Krasny Liman direction.
item.description: 'We work 24/7, no days off': the Zapad Group's servicemen neutralise the enemy in Krasny Liman direction. 💥 The main task of our fighters is to disrupt enemy logistics by cutting off the delivery of ammunition and personnel to the positions. They work literally non-stop. 'An order comes in — the group moves quickly and completes the task,' said the UAV team leader with the call sign 'Kham'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered strikes against Ukrainian ports and ships used in the interests of the AFU.
item.description: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered strikes against Ukrainian ports and ships used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of UAV strikes, a dry cargo ship that had delivered cargo intended to support the AFU was hit in the port of Odessa. 💥 In addition, strikes continued against railway infrastructure facilities in the western regions of Ukraine used to transport military-purpose cargo from European countries. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
